title: fuse-flow review findings
description: What one reviewer found in one round of an agent gate. The reviewer writes it; the author reads it.

round.description: The round of the gate this review is for, from 1.

reviewer.description: The model and harness that reviewed, such as gpt-6.1-sol in OpenCode.

summary.description: The reviewer's verdict, in a few sentences.

findings.description: Every finding of this round, most severe first.

priority.description: P0: wrong or unsafe. P1: a requirement missed, or a defect a user would hit. P2: worth fixing. P3: a nit.

title.description: What is wrong, in one sentence that stands on its own.

file.description: The file it is in, relative to the repository root, or null.

evidence.description: What the reviewer saw, quoted or described, so the author can check it.

impact.description: Who or what it hurts, and how.

scope.description: Whether it is a single instance or a broken pattern with other occurrences.

earlier.description: From the second round on: how each finding of earlier rounds was handled.

title.description: The earlier finding, as the author reported it.

status.description: How the earlier finding stands now; accepted means the author's reason for not fixing it holds.
